name: faqgroup-create
description: A FAQ group creation skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to create and publish a new FAQ group under a specified site language, with support for group name, brief description, and SEO data.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to publish into. First call `languages-get`, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

faqgroup.description: Required. Complete FAQ group payload for the new published FAQ group.

group_name.description: Required. FAQ group name, up to 100 characters.

brief_description.description: Optional. Short plain-text description, up to 300 characters.

seo.description: Optional. SEO metadata for search engines.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact FAQ group creation request after seeing the final language and payload.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact FAQ group payload to be created.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language and exact FAQ group payload shown to the user before execution.
